entities.name: Pizza By The Bay

properties.address: Soona Mahal 143, Marine Dr, Churchgate Mumbai, Maharashtra 400020 India
properties.description: Art-deco, monochrome beachfront restaurant offering elevated pizzas, sandwiches, and al fresco breakfast with sea views.
properties.short_description: Art-deco, monochrome beachfront restaurant offering elevated pizzas, sandwiches, and al fresco breakfast with sea views.
properties.cuisine_description: Pizza By The Bay offers a blend of Italian and international cuisine, renowned for its freshly rolled dough pizzas with signature cheese and homemade tomato sauce, authentic pasta dishes, and a popular lunch buffet featuring soups, salads, and sandwiches. The restaurant also serves an extensive breakfast menu and offers a variety of cocktails, mocktails, and alcoholic beverages, with options catering to vegetarian, vegan, and Jain dietary preferences.
properties.overall_description: A celebrated and iconic Mumbai landmark located along the scenic Marine Drive, this restaurant offers a sophisticated yet relaxed dining experience. Known for its extensive selection of thin-crust pizzas, Italian classics, and diverse breakfast menu, it seamlessly blends Art Deco aesthetics with stunning Arabian Sea views. Whether visited for a morning meal by the water or an evening out with cocktails, it remains a favorite destination for both locals and tourists seeking a quintessential seaside atmosphere.
properties.service_description: The restaurant provides dine-in service with both indoor air-conditioned and outdoor al fresco seating overlooking Marine Drive, as well as takeout and delivery options. It operates on a first-come, first-served basis without formal reservations, making it a bustling destination suitable for romantic dinners, family meals, and casual gatherings with friends.
properties.ambience_description: The space exudes a classic, stylish atmosphere with Art Deco-inspired interiors and a relaxed, breezy seaside vibe that feels both sophisticated and welcoming.
properties.amenities_description: The restaurant provides both indoor and outdoor seating options with valet parking and wheelchair access to ensure comfort and convenience.
properties.unique_selling_points: Famous for its stunning location directly facing the Arabian Sea and its history as a long-standing culinary institution, the restaurant is defined by its signature thin-crust pizzas and breezy al fresco dining.
properties.neighborhood_description: Located in the heart of Churchgate, the area is a vibrant, historic neighborhood known for its bustling urban energy and proximity to one of the city's most famous seaside walkways.
properties.physical_setting_description: Situated directly across from the iconic Marine Drive promenade, this restaurant offers panoramic views of the Arabian Sea. It features a blend of indoor, air-conditioned seating and open-air tables that capture the coastal breeze.
properties.customer_demographics_description: The restaurant attracts a diverse clientele ranging from local Mumbai residents to tourists visiting the iconic Marine Drive area, including couples seeking romantic dining, families, and groups of friends drawn to the scenic seaside atmosphere.
